_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or computed here from values that were.

driverless_miles.basis: commercial driverless miles passed in September

on_time_pct.basis: on-time delivery since launch, in percent

delivery_first_year.basis: first year of Charger's expected truck delivery

delivery_last_year.basis: second year of Charger's expected truck delivery

weekly_rate.basis: targeted trucks per week in early December

weeks_behind.basis: 'about six weeks behind', the word read as a number

revenue_2026.basis: expected 2026 revenue, millions of dollars, approximately

q3_revenue.basis: third quarter revenue, millions of dollars

q3_operating_loss.basis: third quarter operating loss including stock-based compensation, millions of dollars

milestone_trucks.basis: the truck milestone expected by the end of February

trucks_end_2027.basis: driverless trucks in operation Aurora expects to exceed at the end of 2027

hardware_start_year.basis: planned start of production, second half of 2027

exemption_years.basis: the FMCSA exemption's term in years, the word read as a number

scale_steps.basis: computed: the weigh station steps the letter names (station open, scale lane, scale configuration)

ramp_causes.basis: computed: the three constraints the letter names on the ramp
